name: arterial stent
description: An arterial stent is a tubular device inserted into an artery to improve blood flow.

elements.name: Presence of Arterial Stent
elements.definition: Indicates whether an arterial stent is present in the patient.

values.name: Present
values.definition: An arterial stent is present in the patient.

values.name: Absent
values.definition: No arterial stent is present in the patient.

elements.name: Status
elements.definition: Indicates the status of the arterial stent.

values.name: New placement
values.definition: The arterial stent has been newly placed.

values.name: Unchanged
values.definition: The arterial stent remains unchanged.

values.name: Complication
values.definition: The arterial stent has complications.

values.name: Removed
values.definition: The arterial stent has been removed.

elements.name: Location
elements.definition: Indicates the location of the arterial stent.

values.name: Carotid artery
values.definition: The arterial stent is located in the carotid artery.

values.name: Subclavian artery
values.definition: The arterial stent is located in the subclavian artery.

values.name: Brachial artery
values.definition: The arterial stent is located in the brachial artery.

values.name: Cephalic artery
values.definition: The arterial stent is located in the cephalic artery.

elements.name: Side
elements.definition: Indicates the side of the body where the arterial stent is located.

values.name: Left
values.definition: The arterial stent is located on the left side of the body.

values.name: Right
values.definition: The arterial stent is located on the right side of the body.

elements.name: Stent Length
elements.definition: The length of the arterial stent.

elements.name: Stent Diameter
elements.definition: The diameter of the arterial stent.

elements.name: Intimal Hyperplasia
elements.definition: Indicates the presence or absence of intimal hyperplasia around the arterial stent.

values.name: Present
values.definition: Intimal hyperplasia is present around the arterial stent.

values.name: Absent
values.definition: No intimal hyperplasia is present around the arterial stent.

elements.name: In-Stent Restenosis
elements.definition: Indicates the presence or absence of in-stent restenosis in the arterial stent.

values.name: Present
values.definition: In-stent restenosis is present in the arterial stent.

values.name: Absent
values.definition: No in-stent restenosis is present in the arterial stent.

elements.name: Stent Fracture
elements.definition: Indicates the presence or absence of stent fracture in the arterial stent.

values.name: Present
values.definition: Stent fracture is present in the arterial stent.

values.name: Absent
values.definition: No stent fracture is present in the arterial stent.

elements.name: Stent Migration
elements.definition: Indicates the presence or absence of stent migration in the arterial stent.

values.name: Present
values.definition: Stent migration is present in the arterial stent.

values.name: Absent
values.definition: No stent migration is present in the arterial stent.

elements.name: Peri-stent Leak
elements.definition: Indicates the presence or absence of peri-stent leak in the arterial stent.

values.name: Present
values.definition: Peri-stent leak is present in the arterial stent.

values.name: Absent
values.definition: No peri-stent leak is present in the arterial stent.

elements.name: Thrombosis
elements.definition: Indicates the presence or absence of thrombosis in the arterial stent.

values.name: Present
values.definition: Thrombosis is present in the arterial stent.

values.name: Absent
values.definition: No thrombosis is present in the arterial stent.
